mods.name: TNT Warning
mods.description: Warns players when stacked TNT minecarts are nearby.

releases.notes:
Key Changes in the Update

F3 / F3+B Hitbox Fix: Removed the client.getDebugOverlay().showDebugScreen() check. Previously, pressing F3 or F3+B triggered an early return that completely shut off the renderer while debug overlay or hitboxes were active.

Minecraft 1.21+ Matrix Compatibility: Switched transformation calls to use the 2D Matrix3x2fStack (pushMatrix(), popMatrix(), and 2D translate(x, y)) required by modern GuiGraphics in 1.21.2+.

Camera Coordinate Accuracy: Replaced non-existent camera position getters with client.player.getEyePosition(tickDelta) to ensure precise 3D-to-2D screen projections across all mapping versions.

Entity Detection Logging: Added [TNT-Warn Debug] console output (carts.size()) so you can verify in terminal if TNT minecarts are being detected properly in the surrounding chunk box.

releases.notes:
1. Rendering & Clustering Overhaul (TntWarnHudRenderer)

TNT Cart Clustering: Added CartCluster logic to group TNT minecarts within a 1.5-block radius, ensuring reliable detection of stacked carts even across block boundaries.

Smooth 3D Icon Tracking: Upgraded 3D world rendering using matrix translations instead of screen-space projections, providing smooth icon tracking above cart clusters.

Dual Render Modes: Supports toggling between 3D world icons floating over threats and an on-screen HUD list.

2. Keybind System (TntWarnKeybinds)
Registered 4 dedicated controls under the tntwarn category:

Toggle Mod: Instantly turn warnings on or off.

Open Config: Directly open the configuration screen.

Switch Render Mode: Cycle between 3D World Icons and On-Screen HUD List.

Cycle Colors: Switch warning color schemes on the fly.

3. Config & Mod Menu Integration (TntWarnConfig & ModMenu)

Full Mod Menu API integration with custom config screens.

Configurable Settings:

Master Toggle: Enable or disable mod detection.

Render Mode: Select visual layout preference.

Warning Threshold: Set minimum cart stack count to trigger an alert (default: 3, min: 2).

Max Distance: Adjust maximum detection radius for incoming TNT/carts.

4. Repo Cleanup & Git Reset

Purged cached Fabric Loom JARs, compiled .class files, and build/ outputs from Git tracking.

Configured .gitignore to keep .gradle/, build/, out/, and .idea/ out of version control permanently.

Resolved stuck merge/rebase states and force-pushed a clean source repository to GitHub.
